notes.title: SOFIE: THE ECHOES - Patch 1.0.2 is Available Now!
notes.content:
We’ve just rolled out a new update addressing a couple of issues some players encountered. Here’s what’s been fixed:


 Map Loading Issue: Some players experienced the map failing to load when starting a new game. This is now resolved, so you can dive straight into the adventure without any interruptions.
 Weapon Spawn Bug: We’ve fixed a glitch where the gun wasn’t appearing at the beginning of Level 3. It should now spawn correctly, ensuring you’re well-equipped for the challenges ahead.


Thank you for your feedback and patience as we continue refining Sofie: The Echoes. We’re committed to delivering a smooth and immersive experience, and your support helps us get there.

Happy gaming,

Working Game Studio Team

notes.title: SOFIE: THE ECHOES - Patch 1.0.1 is Available Now!
notes.content:
Hello Sofie: The Echoes Community!

Thank you for the amazing support you’ve shown as Sofie embarks on her journey. We’ve loved seeing your recordings, discussions, and all the enthusiasm around the game!

Our first update is live on Steam! We’ve addressed some key feedback to make your experience even better.

Check out the patch notes below and let us know your thoughts. Thanks again for being part of Sofie’s adventure!

Check out the full patch notes below:


PATCH 1.0.1 CHANGELOG:

AI & Gameplay Enhancements


 Improved AI: Enemies now react more naturally to sounds and have enhanced visual detection for an immersive and challenging experience.

 Character Movement: Sofie can now move as normal—even when injured—and her footstep sounds have been reduced when crouching for a stealthier approach.

 New Panic Indicator: Players will now see an on-screen message when Sofie experiences a panic attack, adding clarity to intense moments.


Fixes & Optimizations


 Audio Fixes: Background and effect sounds now play consistently to ensure a fully immersive experience.

 Navigation Improvements: AI behavior is more reliable, preventing instances of enemies getting stuck while navigating the environment.

 Map Loading: Resolved an issue where some users experienced incomplete map loading in the first level after the elevator.

 Input & Interaction: Fixed cases where Sofie was unresponsive to movement inputs after attempting to get the gun and pressing the elevator button. Players should also now be able to pick up the gun without issues.


Animation Refinements


 Sofie’s Skirt Animation: Sofie’s skirt now behaves realistically when she falls, reducing unnecessary animation.

 Death Animation: We’ve minimized Sofie’s ragdoll physics to prevent excessive movement upon death, ensuring a smoother visual experience.

 Cover Adjustments: Sofie’s positioning when taking cover is now more accurate, improving her interaction with walls.


Environment Fixes


 Warzone Map Update (Level 2): The road in Level 2 has been fixed for improved gameplay navigation and aesthetic consistency.


Thank you for your patience and for reporting issues as we continue to improve your experience. We appreciate your understanding and ongoing support.

notes.title: First Look at Sofie: The Echoes Gameplay!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=13EKn1eRRiE;full][/previewyoutube]

We are thrilled to share the first look at the gameplay of Sofie: The Echoes! 🎮✨

In Sofie: The Echoes, you’ll step into the shoes of Sofie, a determined mom and college professor on a desperate quest to find her missing husband and son. Experience a journey filled with:


 Rich, narrative-driven storytelling 📖: Unravel the mystery and immerse yourself in Sofie’s emotional and gripping story.
 Dynamic combat mechanics ⚔️: Engage in intense battles using a variety of weapons and abilities.
 Stunning and immersive visuals 🌄: Explore beautifully crafted environments from ancient ruins to modern cityscapes.
 Challenging puzzles 🧩: Solve intricate puzzles and uncover hidden secrets throughout the game.


Check out our gameplay trailer on https://youtu.be/13EKn1eRRiE?si=o3k5bfgjoWfO_OxN and let us know what you think in the comments below!

Join the conversation and share your excitement with fellow fans. Stay tuned for more updates and exclusive content as we get closer to the Q3 2024 release!

Thank you for your support,
Working Game Studio Team
